name: SASBDB_search
description: Search SASBDB small-angle scattering database by query term or UniProt accession. UniProt IDs return matching entries directly. Because SASBDB has no full-text search API, other queries explicitly fall back to the published-entry catalog; total_entries, has_more, and next_offset make that catalog fully pageable. Use SASBDB_get_entry with a specific code for full details.

query.description: Search query: UniProt accession (e.g., 'P02769' for BSA) or free-text term. Note: SASBDB has no full-text search API; UniProt accessions are resolved directly.

max_results.description: Page size when a free-text query falls back to listing the published-entry catalog. Default 50.

offset.description: Zero-based catalog offset for free-text fallback results. Continue with next_offset while has_more is true.

name: SASBDB_search_entries
description: Search SASBDB for small-angle scattering entries by molecular type (protein, rna, dna, heterocomplex, other) or list all entries. Returns entry codes and publication status.

molecular_type.description: Filter by molecule type: 'protein', 'rna', 'dna', 'heterocomplex', 'other'. Leave null to list all entries.

name: SASBDB_get_entry
description: Get detailed metadata for a SASBDB small-angle scattering entry by its accession code. Returns experimental conditions, publication info, data file URLs, and analysis results.

experiment_description.description: What was measured, in the depositors' words.

experimental_mw.description: Molecular weight determined from the data, in kDa, e.g. 148.0. Compare with the sequence weight to see the oligomeric state.

fits.description: Model fits against the data, each with the model, its plot and the fit quality. This is what connects the curve to a structure.

guinier_i0.description: Forward scattering intensity I(0) from the Guinier fit, e.g. 0.000257. With the concentration this gives the molecular weight.

guinier_point_first.description: First data point used in the Guinier fit, e.g. 1.

guinier_point_last.description: Last data point used, e.g. 35. The fit range is how a Guinier analysis is judged: too wide and the fit is invalid.

guinier_rg.description: Radius of gyration from the Guinier fit, in nm, e.g. 3.18. The headline size measurement of a SAXS experiment, and it was undeclared.

guinier_rg_error.description: Uncertainty on guinier_rg, e.g. 0.02. An Rg without its error cannot be compared with another.

intensities_guinier_plot.description: URL of the Guinier plot, which is how the fit range above is checked by eye.

intensities_kratky_plot.description: URL of the Kratky plot, which is how folded is told from disordered.

intensities_log_log_plot.description: Filename or URL of the log-log plot.

intensity_unit.description: Units of the scattering intensity, e.g. '1/cm'. Without it the intensities cannot be put on an absolute scale.

last_modified.description: When the entry was last changed, ISO 8601.

pddf_dmax.description: Maximum particle dimension from the P(r), in nm, e.g. 8.95. The second shape number after Rg.

pddf_rg.description: Radius of gyration from the pair-distance distribution, e.g. 3.24. Compare with guinier_rg: a large disagreement means one of the analyses is wrong.

pddf_software.description: Which program produced the P(r), e.g. 'ATSAS GNOM'. The result depends on it.

porod_volume.description: Porod volume in nm^3, e.g. 206.43. An independent estimate of particle volume.

sascif_data.description: URL of the sasCIF file: the deposited data in its archival format.

name: SASBDB_get_entries_by_uniprot
description: Find SASBDB small-angle scattering entries associated with a UniProt protein accession. Returns list of matching SASBDB entry codes.

uniprot_id.description: UniProt accession (e.g. P00698 for lysozyme, P68871 for hemoglobin)

name: SASBDB_list_instruments
description: List all beamlines and instruments in the SASBDB database used for small-angle scattering experiments.

detector.description: The detector: its type, name and resolution. What the data was recorded on, and absent from the row before.

resolution.description: Detector resolution as SASBDB records it.

beam_geometry.description: Beam geometry as SASBDB records it, e.g. '0.60'.

point_source.description: Set on point-collimation instruments; null on the others. Point and line collimation need different desmearing, so which one it is changes how the curve must be treated.

line_collimation.description: Set on line-collimation instruments; null on the others.

beam_profile_ah.description: Horizontal beam-profile parameter, where the instrument records one.

beam_profile_al.description: Vertical beam-profile parameter, where the instrument records one.

sample_path_length.description: Sample path length, where recorded. Null on most entries.

name: SASBDB_get_entries_by_tag
description: Find SASBDB small-angle scattering entries associated with a specific tag shortcode. See https://www.sasbdb.org/tags/ for valid tags.

tag.description: Tag shortcode to search for (e.g. 'idp' for intrinsically disordered proteins, 'sans', 'waxs', 'benchmark', 'softmatter')
